meta.name: King Of Jazz
meta.description: A large-scale revue musical built around Paul Whiteman and his orchestra, presenting a series of musical performances, sketches, and staged tableaux in early two-color Technicolor, emblematic of Hollywood’s early sound-era “all-star” musical productions.
meta.slogan: A NEW ERA in sound and color entertainment!
